Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/tests/01-auth.spec.ts

This is a Playwright test file for authentication flows (User Story 1).

The test file should contain:
1. Test suite "Authentication" with:
   a. "successful login with learner credentials" — logs in as alice@example.com/password123, verifies redirect to /Courses/Index and account name shows "Alice Johnson"
   b. "rejects invalid credentials" — submits wrong password, verifies error message displayed and stays on login page
   c. "successful login with admin credentials" — logs in as admin@example.com/password123, verifies admin nav links are visible
   d. "logout clears session" — logs in, navigates to /Account/Logout, verifies redirect to /Account/Login and account control is not visible

Use:
- import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
- import { testUsers } from '../utils/testUsers'
- baseURL: http://localhost:5000 (configured in playwright.config.ts)
- Direct page.locator calls for selectors (no need for page objects in this simple test)

Important selectors from the actual pages:
- Login page: getByLabel('Email'), getByLabel('Password'), getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' }), .error-message
- Account name: .account-name
- Admin links: .admin-link elements
- Account control: #account-control
